data_source.name: EUROCONTROL Open Performance Data Initiative (OPDI) flight events v0.0.2 (opdi.aero), derived from OpenSky Network state vectors

mechanism: stack_resid_v3's guarded LightGBM residual learner refitted with 14 label-free OPDI surface columns appended to its 65 inputs (take-off minus the OPDI take-off reference, stand / apron exit, first taxiway entry, first seen, runway entry, taxiway count, de-icing pad flag and duration, a match flag, and four of these times minus the chain's prediction), matched to departures by airport + callsign with the OPDI take-off reference within [-900, +300] s of the supplied take-off; only OPDI events up to that reference enter. The OPDI learner's value replaces v3's stacking value only on rows with an OPDI match that its support guard (v3's guard extended to the OPDI columns) does not hold, at every airport but LIRF; every other row keeps v3's value, LIRF keeps v2 (as v3), LIRF population and guard rows are fixed.

rule.text: v57's clauses with configs/own_motion_v2.json's values, read on the four development months against the pinned v66 proxy: accepted when (1) no development month (January, July, November, December 2025) is worse than the control by more than 0.005% of complete-month RMSE; (2) the equal-footing mean (January, July, December 2025) of the complete-month RMSE change is at most -0.02%; (3) every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval of the RMSE difference (tools/run_intruder_bound.interval, seed 20261004) lies below zero; (4) transfer guard as stack_resid_v3's rule 4: per airport with at least 200 OPDI-used rows on both sides, the RMS of the OPDI learner's change against v3's value on the ranking rows where it is used, over the same RMS on the development rows (month-blocked, out of month), lies in [0.5, 2.0]. No twelve-month check exists (the stacking components cover only the four development months); stated, not substituted.
